history_summary: Add the Pseudobacillus badius species-reference GTDB correspondence
history_details: Preserve source Bacillus badius NBRC 15713 naming and canonical Pseudobacillus badius identity, all three study stocks and existing Nitrosomonas/Nitrobacter blocks. Native NCBI species-ID correspondence has 26 reference genomes/fraction 1.0; it does not identify the experimental-stock assembly. Only taxonomy[0]'s GTDB block/status and two native inline events changed. The earlier c4s5 correction, source quotations, abstract-only cultivation limits and every biological claim remain unchanged. Scoped database and provenance correction; full scientific approval and corpus QC are separate.
